job.name: FreeTestRetryScan
job.reason: The recurring scan and four-table state machine own bounded retry; overlapping provider-level retries are disabled.

activation_gate: Deploy and read back both Development function targets from the same SOURCE_REVISION.
Provision and read back the exact four-table schema, unique constraints, permissions, and PII/ePHI validators.
Run one immediate synthetic retry Job and verify safe logs and durable state convergence.
Enable the predefined Cron only after the immediate Job passes; then read back enabled status and target/pool ownership.
rollback: Disable the Cron first, then stop the two synthetic deployment rows and remove the Retell number webhook bindings. Preserve durable rows.
